# Smile Makeovers in Mantua, VA


Serving Mantua, VA — a short drive from our Fairfax Station office.

Natural results designed around your face

Preview your smile before you commit

Planned by Dr. Chris and crafted with experienced ceramists


## Because Sometimes, “Good Enough” Isn’t Enough


A small touch-up may not be enough when what you really want is a turning point. Whether it is a wedding, a career-defining presentation, a milestone birthday, a reunion, or simply the everyday confidence of liking what you see in the mirror, a smile makeover is designed around the moment that matters to you.

A smile makeover isn't a single procedure. It's a complete reimagining of your smile, covering color, shape, bite, and harmony, crafted to look naturally like you, only better.

At Livewell Dental, we combine the art of cosmetic design with the science of restoring function. Whether you've lived with worn, mismatched, missing, or damaged teeth for years, or you've simply never truly loved your smile, we bring every tool, every skill, and every detail to the table.

Start Your Makeover Journey


## When Everything Falls Into Place


Imagine walking into that moment knowing your smile is the last thing you are worried about.


### The Wedding Day


You have planned every detail, and your smile will be part of the photos you keep for life. With one patient at a time care, careful planning, and natural-looking design, we help you feel confident from every angle without looking overdone.


### A Fresh Start


Some smiles need rebuilding, not retouching. Because Dr. Chris is one of the few dentists trained in both advanced cosmetics and complex restorative work, we can take on what you were told was beyond repair — and it will function as well as it looks.


### Work, Meetings and Cameras


A presentation, a promotion, a headshot, or simply a day of back-to-back video calls. If you have been managing your smile in meetings, digital previews let you see the planned result before any treatment begins.


### Reunions & Milestones


High school reunions, milestone birthdays, retirement parties, show up feeling like the best version of yourself. Our planning and technology help us work within your timeline without cutting corners.


### Everyday Joy


Sometimes the “big moment” is simply waking up and liking what you see in the mirror. We design smiles that fit your personality, lifestyle, and long-term health.

Let’s Create Your Moment


## A Complete Transformation, Planned to Perfection


Invisalign / Orthodontics

Custom-made shells bonded to the front of your teeth. They change the shape, shade, and proportion of each tooth individually. At Livewell, every veneer is designed using dentofacial analysis and fabricated by master ceramists who specialize in natural-looking restorations.

learn more

When a tooth needs more than surface-level change, a crown restores its full shape and strength while matching the aesthetics of the surrounding teeth. Often part of a makeover when structural and cosmetic needs overlap.

Professional-grade whitening that goes beyond what strips and trays can reach. Used as a standalone treatment or as a finishing step to match veneers, crowns, or bonding to the brightest natural shade your teeth can achieve.

Composite resin applied directly to the tooth to repair chips, close small gaps, or reshape edges. Conservative, often completed in a single visit, and blended to match the exact shade and texture of your natural teeth.

When too much gum tissue makes teeth look short or uneven, recontouring reshapes the gumline to create symmetry and proportion. The frame matters as much as the teeth inside it.

Alignment correction before or alongside cosmetic work. Straightening your teeth first can reduce the amount of reshaping or bonding needed, which means a more conservative final result.

Dr. Chris is a graduate of the UCSF School of Dentistry and its AEGD residency program.

His training in cosmetics, restorative dentistry, bite function, and complex treatment planning helps him design smile makeovers that look natural and function comfortably.

## Smile Makeovers, Done the Livewell Way


Your makeover follows a blueprint. Every step is designed, reviewed, and confirmed before anything permanent happens. You will know what your result looks like before we begin.

Discovery and Design

We photograph your face, your teeth, and your smile from every angle that matters. Using dentofacial analysis and digital smile design, Dr. Chris maps the relationship between your teeth, your lips, your jawline, and your facial proportions. The goal is a design that belongs to your face, not a template pulled from a catalog.

Preview You Can Try On

Before any tooth is touched, you see your result. A physical preview is built so you can wear your new smile temporarily, check it in different lighting, and decide whether it feels right. If something needs to change, it changes now, not after the final restorations are placed.

Preparation

Once the design is locked, the teeth are prepared. For veneers, this means minimal reshaping of the front surface. For crowns, a more complete reduction. For bonding, often no preparation at all. The approach depends on the tooth and the restoration, not a standard formula.

Handcrafted Fabrication

Your restorations are built by experienced ceramists who receive the full photography package, digital design, and specific shade instructions captured with PolarEyes. The goal is a close partnership where the ceramist understands the same details Dr. Chris sees.

Delivery and Final Verification

Each restoration is tried in, checked against the original design, and verified for shade, fit, and bite before it is permanently bonded. We photograph the final result and compare it to the plan. What you approved is what you get.


## Where Advanced Training Meets Artistry


Beautiful, natural-looking results come from more than technique. Dr. Chris's training at the Kois Center and his close work with a master ceramist mean every veneer and cosmetic restoration is shaped around your face, your bite, and the way you want to feel when you smile.


## The Livewell Smile Makeover Experience


Your makeover is not just a set of procedures. It is an experience designed to feel comfortable, personal, and carefully planned. This is where science, artistry, and one-on-one care come together.


### Private


One-patient-at-a-time visits allow our team to focus fully on your care.


### Ceramist Partnership


We partner with experienced ceramists so restorations are carefully crafted, not treated like factory-made pieces.


### Technology


Digital previews help you understand the planned result before permanent treatment begins.


### Scheduling


Flexible scheduling supports both time-sensitive events and carefully phased treatment plans.


### Expertise


Experience in implants, full-mouth rehabilitation, and aesthetics helps us manage complex smile transformations under one roof.


## The Livewell Smile Collection


Designed with Purpose. Crafted to Belong.


### Perfect 1


One tooth. Perfectly matched. A single restoration (veneer, crown, or bonding) crafted to vanish into your natural smile with microscopic precision.


### Magic 4


Four front teeth. One magical transformation. Ideal for fixing wear, discoloration, or imbalance in the most visible zone of your smile.


### Social 10


Ten upper teeth, harmonized to perfection. Balanced, bright, and confident — ready for any setting, any angle, any moment.

## Why Mantua Patients Choose Their Smile Makeover at Livewell


A few things that are different about planning your makeover here, a short drive from Mantua.

01


### Fast-Track When You Have a Date


A wedding, a reunion, a presentation that matters. Tell us the date at your consultation and we prioritise your case and plan backwards from it, preview appointment included.

02


### Phased Care When You Don't


No deadline, or you would rather stage the investment? We map a clear, milestone-based plan so you can begin when you are ready and stop at any point that makes sense.

03


### Comfort Through Every Visit


Minimally invasive where possible, sedation available when appropriate, and one patient at a time, so a visit that took you a drive to reach never feels rushed.

What is a smile makeover and what does it include?

A smile makeover is a combination of cosmetic dental procedures planned and executed together to transform the appearance of your smile. It can include porcelain veneers, dental crowns, teeth whitening, bonding, gum recontouring, and orthodontic alignment. The specific combination depends on your goals, your facial structure, and the current condition of your teeth. At Livewell, every makeover is designed using photography, digital mapping, and a physical preview before anything permanent begins.

Can I see what my smile will look like before I commit?

Yes. Before any permanent work begins, a physical preview is created so you can wear your new smile temporarily and evaluate it in real life. If the shape, shade, or proportion needs adjusting, those changes happen before anything is finalized. You approve the result before it becomes permanent.

How many visits will a smile makeover take, and how far apart are they?

It depends on the scope. A bonding-only case may be one or two visits. A full veneer case typically runs three to six weeks from preparation to final placement, with a consultation, a design and preview appointment, the preparation visit, and delivery. Multi-phase plans that include orthodontics or gum work run longer. Dr. Chris gives you the full schedule at your consultation, so you know how many trips to plan for before you commit to anything.

Are smile makeovers covered by insurance?

Most dental insurance plans classify smile makeovers as elective cosmetic treatment and do not cover them. However, individual components like crowns may receive partial coverage if they also serve a functional purpose. Our team reviews your benefits before treatment begins and walks you through what, if anything, applies.

What is the difference between Perfect 1, Magic 4, and Social 10?

These describe the scope of the makeover. Perfect 1 focuses on a single tooth, matched perfectly to the surrounding teeth. Magic 4 covers your four front teeth, transforming the center of your smile. Social 10 addresses all ten upper teeth visible when you smile or speak. The right scope depends on your goals and your starting point, which is determined during your consultation.

Where is the practice, and how far is it from Mantua?

Livewell Dental is at 9027 Silverbrook Road, Suite F, Fairfax Station, VA 22039, a short drive south of the City of Fairfax. We see patients from Mantua regularly, and the team is happy to help you pick an appointment time that works around the traffic on your route. Call 703-690-0102 and we will talk it through.
